ideas.pitch: A time-series forecasting and risk simulation platform that predicts student engagement drop-offs and administrative bottlenecks using Poisson regression and calibrated confidence intervals.
ideas.title: Erazone AI Incident Forecasting Hub
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the winning pattern of hard technical implementation from the Apart Research AI Forecasting Hackathon by replacing basic charts with statistically rigorous probabilistic predictions.

ideas.pitch: An investigative dashboard designed for student union treasuries to detect anomalous transactions, fund misallocations, and compliance risks using graph intelligence and LightGBM.
ideas.title: CampusGuard Graph AML
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the architecture of the DIGITIMES AI Innovation Hackathon winner, focusing on heavy graph-based relationship mapping and explainable risk scores that appeal to technical judges.

ideas.pitch: A hyper-personalized campus cafeteria meal planner that reads student biometric inputs, schedules, and local mess menus to dynamically optimize daily nutritional intake.
ideas.title: MessMate AI Nutrition Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the winning blueprint of the Mealzy 24-Hour Hackathon by solving an immediate, relatable daily problem for students with a polished, consumer-ready interface.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite monitoring tool that tracks unauthorized green-space degradation and construction waste across large university campuses using aerial imagery processing.
ideas.title: EcoCampus Satellite Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the technical success of the Xcelerate Hackathon runner-up, bringing real-world geospatial intelligence to a localized academic environment.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven platform for prospective university applicants that aggregates peer reviews, verified alumni outcomes, and automated FAQ responses to build trust for institutional programs.
ideas.title: CampusAdmit Trust Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the fast-paced conversion mechanics of the Elevate X hackathon winner, packaging complex institutional data into a clean, high-trust user experience.
